top_signals.title: Chip Rebound, Amazon Results Bolster Stock Rally | Bloomberg Brief 07/31/26
top_signals.summary: US equity futures gain after chipmakers including Samsung and SK Hynix rebounded and Amazon posted strong earnings. The Bank of Japan keeps its policy rate unchanged following a currency intervention, which strengthened the yen against the dollar. Jane Foley of Rabobank discusses this week's central bank rate decisions. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Maruti Suzuki’s Profit Disappoints as High Input Costs Bite
top_signals.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd.’s profit again missed analysts’ estimates as rising commodity costs offset a robust revenue growth and healthy jump in exports.
